mapper.select: select IFNULL( (select last_read_id from notification_read_state where recipient_id = #{recipientId} and notification_group = #{notificationGroup}), 0)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_read_state (recipient_id, notification_group, last_read_id, last_read_at) VALUES (#{recipientId}, #{notificationGroup}, #{lastReadId}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_read_id = GREATEST(last_read_id, #{lastReadId}), last_read_at = NOW()
